parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake and guardrails
Validates the versioned incident contract, rejects secret-like fields, assigns correlation and idempotency keys, and supports a controlled failure test.

## 2 · Deterministic continuity engine
Loads future sessions, evaluates role and time-window coverage, scores candidates, creates version-checked updates and explains the recommendation.

## Portfolio safety
Original logic and synthetic data only. No company APIs, credentials, customer records or proprietary implementation. The workflow proposes changes but the website performs the human-approved database commit.
